status: post-R1 exploratory engineering comparison; lock before fit; same 19 sealed inputs
motivation: scalar norm cap removes axial signal before target-space projection
objective: minimize sum squared error to unscaled relative prefix + sum squared second differences (unit knot weight); initialize at the consumed command. 16 source knots at 30 Hz, then hold. controls: reflect all positive axial components backwards; keep original transverse motion
gate: unchanged C², shared no-contact H40 and 15 mm clearance on standing geometry. Record reference-only endpoint in the initial 9 seconds, plus full selected prefix, with no native advance. Only original native observations can be used to score the physical task.
